main.description: A physical book the reader owns: one Copy of an Edition. A reader can own several Copies of the same Edition. Never Shared.

isbn.description: The Edition: ISBN-13, 13 digits, no hyphens.

works.description: Catalog identifiers of the Works this Copy contains; several for an omnibus. 'isbn:<isbn13>' when the Catalog does not know the Work.

lentTo.description: Who has this Copy now. Absent when the reader has it.

acquiredAt.description: When the reader got this Copy, if they said.

details.description: Typed by the reader when the Catalog does not know this ISBN.

series.description: Series title, as typed. Not a Catalog identifier.

volume.description: Volume in the Series, as printed (e.g. '12', '12.5').
